component.name: MSI-TESE Phase Alpha
component.description: Vulnerable baseline. NO cryptographic protection: plaintext telemetry, commands, and storage end to end. This CBOM documents the absence of crypto assets and the resulting cleartext attack surface.

properties.name: msi:cleartext-channels
properties.value: MQTT/TCP telemetry; HTTP control; Modbus/TCP (no integrity); plaintext historian storage

components.name: MQTT (plaintext)
components.description: Field/edge telemetry transported over MQTT on TCP :1883 with no transport encryption — fully observable, the C2 exfiltration baseline.

components.name: Modbus/TCP (no integrity)
components.description: PLC control traffic with no authentication or integrity — commands can be observed, injected, or modified.
